title: The Lord's Judgment on Jerusalem and King Zedekiah
description: King Zedekiah sends Pashhur and the priest Zephaniah to the prophet Jeremiah to ask the Lord for help against Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians who are besieging Jerusalem. But Jeremiah delivers a harsh answer: The Lord himself will fight against the city with outstretched hand and fury, and people and animals shall die from plague, sword, and famine. Zedekiah and the people shall be given into Nebuchadnezzar's hand. Nevertheless, the Lord sets before them the way of life and the way of death: Whoever remains in the city shall die, but whoever surrenders to the Chaldeans shall save their life as plunder.
